slug: 2026-02-02 Namibian regulator proposes tax breaks on 4G devices

facts.fact: ITWeb reports ICT minister Emma Theofelus distributed 100 mobile phones paid for from the Universal Service Fund to top learners at the Ehomba tower launch in Kunene, the weekend before 2 February 2026.

note: The CRAN proposal of tax breaks on 4G devices is a tax break, class other, and gives no fact.
